title: Self-convolution of a quadratic sign function
statement: Let $n$ be an even natural number, and let $z\\in (\\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. Define $q(x)=\\sum_{0\\le i<j<n}x_i x_j$ in $\\mathbb{F}_2$, and set $f(x)=(-1)^{q(x)}$. With convolution normalized by the uniform average on $(\\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, the self-convolution satisfies $(f*f)(z)=1$ if $z=0$, and $(f*f)(z)=0$ otherwise.
